_comment: BT-4200, reshaped by BT-4292: how dynamic dispatch routes every class whose instances are NOT a '$beamtalk_class'-tagged map of their own name. Single source of truth for the compiler's representation facts: crates/beamtalk-codegen/src/core_erlang/routing_table.rs is GENERATED from this file (TYPE_TESTS type-pattern guards, the typed-sealed exclusion set, the reserved tuple tags, the dynamic-site report's built-in reasons); regenerate with `ROUTING_TABLE_BLESS=1 cargo test -p beamtalk-codegen --lib routing_table`, and the drift test `routing_table_is_generated_from_fixture` fails until you do. The runtime half is beamtalk_tagged_map_routing_conformance_tests (EUnit), which sends every row's sample through the dynamic path and checks it reaches 'target_module', that the special selectors really are special, and that every 'dynamic_only' reason still holds. Add or change a row here, re-bless, and both sides must agree or a test fails. See '_fields' for what each row field means.

_fields.class: the class name a static type or a type pattern names
_fields.aliases: other class names that denote the same class (type patterns only)
_fields.representation: raw_term: a plain Erlang term routed by beamtalk_primitive:module_for_value; untagged_map: a map with no class tag (Dictionary by convention); record: a #beamtalk_object{} class object; proxy_routed: a tagged map routed to a fixed native module (beamtalk_primitive:proxy_routes/0); supervisor_tuple: a {beamtalk_supervisor, Class, Module, Pid} handle, shared by the class and all its subclasses
_fields.sample: an Erlang expression for a representative instance, or null when the representation is shared with another row or needs a live process
_fields.guard: the representation test that proves a value is an instance (the type-pattern test, and the guard a typed send may stand behind), or null when no representation test exists. kinds: bif (a guard BIF named by 'bif'), string_tag ({beamtalk_string, Bytes}), binary_or_string_tag (a binary or the String tag), unaligned_bitstring (is_bitstring and not is_binary), unreserved_tuple (a tuple whose first element is not a reserved tag of that size, see reserved_tuple_tags), symbol (an atom other than true/false/nil), exact_atom (the one atom named by 'atom'), untagged_map (a map with no '$beamtalk_class' and no '__class_mod__' key)
_fields.target_module: the module whose dispatch/3 the dynamic path calls for an instance, for every selector outside 'special_selectors', or null when there is no single such module
_fields.special_selectors: selectors the dynamic path answers without calling target_module:dispatch/3
_fields.dynamic_only: null, or why a send to this class must stay dynamic even though it has a guard and a target module

rows.dynamic_only: a Character is an integer at run time: the dynamic path routes it to Integer, and Character-typed codegen already claims Character receivers
send_bitstring/3 re-raises a Bitstring does_not_understand with a bit-size hint that bt@stdlib@bitstring:dispatch/3 does not add
true and false dispatch to different modules (True, False)
a class object is a #beamtalk_object{} record answered by its class process
a metaclass object is a #beamtalk_object{} record dispatched through the Metaclass chain
the native proxy is reached through a tagged map whose tag a class-tag guard would have to name; no typed send targets it
a supervisor handle is dispatched by a hierarchy walk in the caller (ADR 0059), not by a module's dispatch/3
a supervisor handle is dispatched by a hierarchy walk in the caller (ADR 0059), not by a module's dispatch/3

reserved_tuple_tags.denotes: an actor instance or a class object (#beamtalk_object{})
